text:
maya: Quick heads-up — running a dry run of the entitlement slimdown in staging at 11:00 PT. Goals: detect orphaned admin grants, validate KMS audit log playback, and practice rollback flow. Will post checklist and logs here.
jon: SGTM. Do we have the runbook for rollback pinned somewhere?
maya: Yes, runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/sec/runbooks/admin-slimdown-dryrun — main rollback steps are at the top. Short version: reapply previous IAM role mapping, reattach KMS grants, and run /rollforward if needed.
ash: ops-bot will do the snapshot and immutable export before any removals, right?
ops-bot: snapshot started: exporter job id export-20260323-11-00. Artifacts: s3://redwood-sec-dryruns/export-4165001234.tar.gz :white_check_mark:
maya: Good — steps I'm going to run: 1) run owner-lookup to mark accounts with no owner 2) propose removals via canary group (5 services) 3) verify KMS grant revoke/reattach cycle for a test key 4) exercise auditlog playback to detect any missing events.
jon: For the KMS step, call out the exact commands you plan to run so SRE can watch latency and error spikes.
maya: Yep. Command I will run in staging:
```
# revoke grant
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/staging-data-key --grant-id 1234-abcd
# reattach grant
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/staging-data-key --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/staging-service-role --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```
ash: Also please capture CloudTrail and our audit-proxy stream for the same window. If playback misses the revoke event we need to open a ticket.
sre-liaison: I'll watch infra metrics and ephemeral tokens — last time a grant rotate caused a spike in token refresh errors for one service.
maya: Noted. Expected risk: transient 401s for services during re-grant. Rollback plan: re-create grant and restart the affected service. If more than 3 services fail, we abort and roll back all changes.
jon: How are we detecting ownerless roles? Is it just last-modified date?
maya: Owner-lookup uses a heuristic: owner tag -> onboarding ticket -> recent last_modified within 180 days. Unowned if no owner tag AND no ticket AND last_modified > 365 days. We surface exceptions for service accounts with exemptions.
ash: Can we add a quick grep for keys with cross-account grants? We should avoid touching keys with external grantees during this run.
maya: Good call. Will exclude keys where grant includes external AWS account IDs.
ops-bot: export artifact verified. checksum: sha256:2b7e151628aed2a6abf7158809cf4f3c
maya: Starting canary removal on services: svc-a, svc-b, svc-c, svc-d, svc-e. Will post small diffs and audit-proxy traces. Please react with :eyes: if you're watching.
jon: :eyes: watching svc-a and svc-b traces
sre-liaison: monitoring infra, will alert on token error rate >0.5%
ash: watching KMS logs and CloudTrail
maya: Canary finished. svc-a had one transient 401, recovered after grant reapply. Audit-proxy shows revoke and create events present and correlated. No missing events.
jon: Nice. Next steps? schedule a broader pass?
maya: Prefers rolling weekly windows for the rest of staging, then schedule prod dry-run in a maintenance window. I'll open the RFC for prod timeline.
ash: Please include a brief blameless note about the transient 401 so support knows what to expect in prod.
maya: Will do. Thanks all.
